name: CINIC-10
description: A 270,000-image classification dataset with ten classes, combining CIFAR-10 images and downsampled ImageNet images to provide train, validation, and test splits.
citation: Darlow, L. N., Crowley, E. J., Antoniou, A., & Storkey, A. J. (2018). CINIC-10 is not ImageNet or CIFAR-10. arXiv:1810.03505. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1810.03505

license.notes: The upstream project does not state a standard license for CINIC-10. The dataset incorporates CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-derived images, whose rights and terms may differ; check the respective providers before use or redistribution.
